import numpy as np
import mujoco
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation

class Controller:
    def __init__(self,s):
        self.s=s
        self.m=s.model
        self.d=mujoco.MjData(self.m)
        self.jids=[self.m.joint('robot0_joint'+str(i)).id for i in range(1,8)]
        self.qids=self.m.jnt_qposadr[self.jids]
        self.vids=self.m.jnt_dofadr[self.jids]
        self.sid=self.m.site('gripper0_right_grip_site').id
        self.R=np.diag([1.,-1.,-1.])
    def ik(self,p,R=None,q=None):
        R=self.R if R is None else R
        self.d.qpos[:]=self.s.data.qpos
        q=self.s.data.qpos[self.qids].copy() if q is None else q.copy()
        for i in range(150):
            self.d.qpos[self.qids]=q
            mujoco.mj_forward(self.m,self.d)
            pos=self.d.site_xpos[self.sid]
            rot=self.d.site_xmat[self.sid].reshape(3,3)
            e=np.r_[np.array(p)-pos,Rotation.from_matrix(R@rot.T).as_rotvec()]
            if np.linalg.norm(e)<1e-5: break
            jp=np.zeros((3,self.m.nv)); jr=jp.copy()
            mujoco.mj_jacSite(self.m,self.d,jp,jr,self.sid)
            J=np.vstack([jp[:,self.vids],jr[:,self.vids]])
            dq=J.T@np.linalg.solve(J@J.T+np.eye(6)*0.0001,e)
            dq*=min(1.,0.15/(np.max(np.abs(dq))+1e-9))
            q=np.clip(q+dq,self.m.jnt_range[self.jids,0]+0.01,self.m.jnt_range[self.jids,1]-0.01)
        if np.linalg.norm(e)>0.005: print('IK residual',e,flush=True)
        return q
    def move(self,p,steps=60,grip=-1,R=None):
        q0=self.s.data.qpos[self.qids].copy()
        q=self.ik(p,R,q0)
        for t in range(steps):
            u=(t+1)/steps
            u=u*u*(3-2*u)
            a=np.r_[q0+(q-q0)*u,grip,0,0,0,0,-1]
            self.s.step(a)
        print('MOVE',len(self.s.actions),'eef',self.s.data.site_xpos[self.sid].round(4),'dessert',self.s.data.body('dessert_main').xpos.round(4),'success',self.s.check(),flush=True)
    def hold(self,steps=20,grip=None):
        a=self.s.hold_targets()
        if grip is not None: a[7]=grip
        for _ in range(steps): self.s.step(a)
        print('HOLD',len(self.s.actions),'eef',self.s.data.site_xpos[self.sid].round(4),'dessert',self.s.data.body('dessert_main').xpos.round(4),'success',self.s.check(),flush=True)
